$comment: Example Antigravity MCP configuration for Frontier Engineer. To enable an integration, set disabled to false and export the required environment variables in your operating system environment before launching Antigravity.

github.description: Provides secure access to GitHub remote repository operations, issue tracking, pull request inspection, and CI workflow status.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN: GitHub personal access token with scoped repository read/write permissions.

context7.description: Enables fast, authoritative technical documentation lookup, library version resolution, and API reference querying.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.CONTEXT7_API_KEY: Optional API key providing elevated rate limits for Context7 documentation queries.

playwright.description: Enables browser automation, interactive DOM inspection, accessibility tree validation, and screenshot capture for UI verification.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS: Controls headless execution mode. Defaults to true for automated and CI environments.

sentry.description: Provides access to Sentry error monitoring, stack trace inspection, crash reports, and release performance metrics.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: Sentry authentication token with read/write access to issues and events.

database.description: Enables schema inspection, index analysis, execution plan generation, and safe read-only queries for relational databases.

requiredEnvironmentVariables.DATABASE_URL: PostgreSQL connection string with read-only credentials (e.g., postgresql://readonly_user:pass@host:5432/dbname).
